references.text: Here we see a parallel event where the mother of James and John asks Jesus for a favor for her sons, similar to the request made by James and John in Mark.
This passage reflects the theme of seeking positions of honor and how Jesus redefines greatness in God's kingdom, which is relevant to the request made by James and John.
This reference to prayer and asking for something in faith can be seen as related to the request made by James and John for a special favor from Jesus.
